THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 7
Land Ministry Ref. No. : 4-3/7/2015/HW/239.
I do hereby give notice, under Sub-section (i) Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the following lands already Acquired for a public purpose are to be acquired under the same act.
